body:
## Why this issue exists

`lib/commands.sh` is 1,384 lines containing 61 functions and 135 aliases covering completely unrelated domains: git, npm, docker, tmux, AWS, DigitalOcean, terraform, SSH, and general shell utilities. This makes the file impossible to test in isolation, difficult to review, and creates unnecessary merge conflicts when multiple concerns are changed.

> **Applies the standard in #153** (dotfiles lib module organization convention). Follow that issue's rules for boundaries, size, naming, and load order. This issue is the first concrete application of it.

## What needs to be done

Split `lib/commands.sh` into focused domain modules, following #153. Suggested split:

- `lib/git.sh` — git aliases and functions (co, merge, branch management, commit helpers)
- `lib/npm.sh` — npm/node detection and helpers
- `lib/docker.sh` — docker/container helpers
- `lib/tmux.sh` — tmux session and window management helpers (large: ~71 keyword hits)
- `lib/cloud.sh` — AWS, DigitalOcean, terraform, SSH cloud helpers. Per #153's boundary rule this stays **one file** until it nears the ~300-line cap, then splits by tool. Do not pre-split the tiny (terraform/ssh) pieces.
- `lib/repo.sh` — repo-scaffolding logic: the `.gitignore` generator (~L712–745) and `mkrepo`. **Do not let this fall into the general bucket.**
- `lib/agent.sh` — agent state: the Claude keep-alive loop (~L375–388) and related helpers.
- `lib/commands.sh` — only what genuinely fits none of the above (general shell utilities).

`lib/index.sh` already sources all `lib/*.sh` files dynamically, so adding new files is automatic.

## Prerequisite (from #153)

Before splitting, make `lib/index.sh` source underscore-prefixed (`_*.sh`) files **first, explicitly**. Under `en_US.UTF-8` the current `ls`/glob ordering sorts `_shared.sh` 10th of 11 — NOT first — so any split that introduces a source-time dependency on `_shared.sh` could silently break. Land the ordering fix (and its test) first.

## How to verify

1. Run: `just test-unit`
2. Run: `just test`
3. Confirm all existing aliases and functions still work in a new shell session
4. Check that `wc -l` on any single `lib/*.sh` file is at or under ~300 lines (soft cap per #153)
5. Confirm `_shared.sh` is sourced before every non-underscore module

## Notes

- See `lib/index.sh` for how sourcing works — it globs `lib/*.sh` excluding `index.sh`
- Do NOT change function signatures or alias names; this is purely a file reorganization
- Run `bashcheck` on each new file after splitting (bashcheck is the project linter, not `bash -n`)

*Migrated from beads issue dotfiles-dtk. Refined 2026-07-06 to reference the #153 organization standard (added repo.sh/agent.sh modules, cloud.sh boundary rule, and the index.sh load-order prerequisite).*
title: Split lib/commands.sh monolith into focused modules
